name: warn-system
author: Takaro
description: Warn System — staff warn players with a reason; warnings are stored with date and staff name, expire after a set number of days, and escalate automatically (by default 3 warnings = kick, 5 = 24-hour ban, 7 = permanent ban). Players can check their own warnings, staff can check and remove anyone's. Optional public broadcast and Discord log.

warningExpiryDays.description: Days until a warning expires and stops counting towards escalation. 0 = warnings never expire.

escalation.description: What happens when a player reaches a number of active warnings. Each step runs once, when the count is reached exactly.

warnings.description: Number of active warnings that triggers this step

action.description: kick, tempban (ban for durationHours) or ban (permanent)

durationHours.description: Ban length in hours (only for tempban)

warnMessage.default: You have been warned by {staff}: {reason}. Active warnings: {count}. Type {prefix}warnings to see them.
warnMessage.description: Private message to the warned player. Placeholders: {player}, {staff}, {reason}, {count}, {id}, {prefix}

broadcastWarnings.description: Also announce every warning in public chat

broadcastMessage.description: Public message when broadcastWarnings is on. Placeholders: {player}, {staff}, {reason}, {count}

notifyOnJoin.description: Tell a player about warnings they got while offline when they next join

discordChannelId.description: Discord channel ID for a warning log. Leave empty to turn the Discord log off.

permissions.description: Allows a player to warn other players and to view anyone's warnings
Allows a player to remove warnings (unwarn) and to view anyone's warnings

warn.helpText: Usage: warn <player> <reason> — warns a player. Repeated warnings escalate to kick and ban. Needs WARN_ISSUE.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.helpText: Why the player is warned (the rest of the line)

warnings.helpText: Usage: warnings [player] — shows your own warnings. Staff can add a player name to see theirs.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name (staff only). Leave empty for your own warnings.

unwarn.helpText: Usage: unwarn <player> <id> — removes one warning. See the id with the warnings command. Needs WARN_MANAGE.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: The player whose warning to remove

arguments.name: id
arguments.helpText: The warning id (shown by the warnings command)

notify-on-join.description: Tells a player about warnings they received while offline
